$comment: IDD in-session mechanical checks — GitHub Copilot hooks (CLI, cloud coding agent, VS Code agent mode; installed as .github/hooks/idd.json per-contributor by idd-activate.sh enable copilot-hooks — never by a checkout, never by install.sh). Envelope follows the field-observed contract: PascalCase event names, command + timeout entry fields, and deny decisions emitted both top-level (CLI) and under hookSpecificOutput (VS Code). Deterministic checks only: PostToolUse runs the committed ast-grep checks on edited files, including paths extracted from V4A apply_patch input records; PreToolUse runs the same checks before a git commit. No judgment review is triggered here and no review attestation is required — judgment review is manual-only (/idd-judgment-review) and advisory. Hooks never signal by exit code (exit 2 means warn-and-continue in Copilot): they emit stdout JSON and exit 0. Silent no-op when tools are missing or nothing applies.

PostToolUse.command:
p=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ls .github/idd/checks/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; t=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolName // .tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$t" in edit|create|str_replace_editor|apply_patch|Edit|Write) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; fs=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolArgs.path // .toolArgs.filePath // .toolArgs.file_path // .tool_input.path // .tool_input.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$fs" ]; then fs=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolArgs.input // .tool_input.input // empty' 2>/dev/null | sed -n -e 's/^\*\*\* Add File: //p' -e 's/^\*\*\* Update File: //p'); fi; fs=$(printf '%s
' "$fs" | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s
' "$f"; done); [ -n "$fs" ] || exit 0; out=$(printf '%s
' "$fs" | xargs ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml 2>&1) || { ctx=$(printf 'IDD mechanical check failed — fix before proposing this diff:
%s
' "$out" | jq -Rs .); printf '{"additionalContext":%s}
' "$ctx"; }; exit 0

PreToolUse.command: p=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; t=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolName // .tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$t" in bash|powershell|run_in_terminal|Bash) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cmd=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolArgs.command // .tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ls .github/idd/checks/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml 2>&1) || { r=$(printf 'IDD mechanical checks failed — fix before committing:\n%s' "$out" | jq -Rs .); printf '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":%s,"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":%s}}\n' "$r" "$r"; }; exit 0
